details: Patient IDs should be unique in Silver patient.
Coverage IDs should be unique in Silver coverage.
EOB IDs should be unique in Silver claim_header.
Every EOB should retain a patient reference.
EOB type.coding should provide a claim type.
Service end date should not precede service start date.
Line service or product code is missing.
Financial adjudication amounts should not be negative.
Every claim line should link to a claim_header row.
Every diagnosis row should link to a claim_header row.
Unsupported adjudication codes remain auditable in claim_line_financial.
Some FHIR line items may omit adjudication arrays.
Provider attribution uses careTeam first, then EOB provider fallback.
Only observed PDE, CARRIER, and OUTPATIENT claim profiles are supported in Phase 2.
